messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the release notes for the docs site (0.9.8). Targeting deploy tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need two quick things: (1) update SDK examples for python + go snippets; (2) a short migration blurb for the new batching config. Who can own snippet sweep?

kai: I can take python snippets. Will open a PR for examples and add code sample tests.

jordan: I'll handle Go + TS snippets. Where should I put the migration guide? new /guides/migrations/batching ?

maria: Yes, create under docs/guides/migrations. Keep it short (3 steps) and add warning about KV cache invalidation. Add a Known Issues section.

kai: noted. Also saw one broken anchor in the streaming embed page: /docs/embeddings#note-stream. I'll fix link in my PR.

docs-bot: deploy-preview created for PR #4821 by kai — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821

ling: FYI QA: the embed streaming change causes a small token-count increase for truncated inputs — add a perf note and the workaround: set max_input_tokens=1024.

sam: For the changelog blurb, should we call it 'batching & caching improvements' or be more specific? Ops want 'KV cache migration note'.

maria: Ops prefers 'KV cache migration note' included under Known Issues. Changelog blurb: 2–3 bullets. Draft in this thread pls.

jordan: Draft: "Batching and cache improvements: reduced per-token latency for high-concurrency workloads. Note: KV cache format changed; existing cached prefixes will be invalidated on rollout — nightly rebuild expected." Thoughts?

kai: LGTM, add a short code snippet showing new config: 
```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_size: 64
  max_latency_ms: 8
  prefix_cache: enabled
```

maria: Perfect. Deadline: PRs + deploy previews by EOD today so docs release team can assemble relnotes. Ping me when ready :pray:

sam: I'll compile final relnotes and draft release note bullets when PRs merged.

maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
